title: Base Mount Bottom
subtitle: #110-001 · reference mesh · feature names for the conversion

labels.text: F1 flange: Ø85 ∪ 4 arms 50 wide to ±75, z 0–16, R5 top edge
H1 mounting holes ×8 Ø6.0, cbore Ø10.0 z 10–16
G1 gussets on ±X: 17 wide, top 30.75° to z 33.18
T1 tower Ø85.0 to shoulder z 82
K1 strake slots ×6, 13.0 × 3.6 on r 35.651, floor z 4
B2 bore Ø20.0 through the hub
H2 hub holes ×6 Ø8.0 on r 22.062, cbore Ø14.0 from z 15
R1 floor: 6 ribs under the columns, scooped between

notes.heading: Frame
notes.text: The J1 axis is +Z through the origin, and z = 0 is the mounting face the Base Mounting Plate bolts to. The ±X arms carry the gussets (G1); the windows (W1) and strake slots (K1) sit at 30° + 60°k, between the tower's six columns. This is the bolted v9 part exported from dde/HDIMeterModel.gltf; the onshape KP0001 STEP is the un-bolted predecessor and is not a source. Toggle the section cut to look at the floor (R1) and the hub (B2, H2).
